evidence.title: 2330 Thalassa historical daily OHLCV (retrieved 2026-09-21)
evidence.text: Actual stored daily OHLCV. SMA uses raw close over 20/60 trading sessions. 20-session change = (close / close 20 sessions earlier - 1) * 100; volume ratio uses current volume divided by 20-session mean including current. Raw prices: not adjusted for dividends/splits; not total return. Historical data retrieved later; point-in-time database revisions are unavailable. Volume unit not verified. No valuation conclusion from this data alone.
